start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

variables.description:
Global variables to supply to a given {@link App.Metric}.
Individual {@link App.Metric} can override these variables by specifying the overrides in
{@link App.Metric.QuerySpec}.
Notice that only values of strings are specified here, global variables for {@link App.Metric#APP_METER_DYNAMIC_REFERENCE meter_d}
and {@link App.Metric#APP_METRIC_DYNAMIC_REFERENCE metric_d} are intentionally not supported. Variable definitions for
these must be set in their respective {@link App.Metric.QuerySpec#variables} instead.

interval.description: The interval between each data point in the resultant timeseries

filled.description:
Whether or not this specific instance has been processed. Especially helpful when calls from the
front end require full resolution and serves as a marker for server to know entire instance has
been fully resolved.

metrics.description: The metrics to evaluate over given time period

title: Complete spec to evaluate an individual {@link App.Metric}.
name: App.Metric.EvaluatableSpec
